title: Trait Collapse in Text-to-Image Generation: Evaluating and Mitigating Personality Inconsistency in Visual Storytelling
abstract: arXiv:2611.20381v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In visual storytelling, a believable character must not only look consistent across scenes but also \textit{behave} in ways that reflect their personality. Current text-to-image (T2I) models preserve visual appearance effectively, yet consistently fail to maintain personality-relevant behavior---a failure we term \textit{trait collapse}. We show that conventional metrics (CLIP Score, DINO similarity) are blind to this failure, and that abstract personality descriptors and scene-level emotion labels do not produce consistent improvements over neutral prompts across models. To systematically diagnose trait collapse, we introduce \textbf{ViStoryBench-Personality}, a story-level benchmark combining an expert-validated Visual Cues Lexicon (Fleiss' $\kappa = 0.757$) with a six-dimensional metric suite covering personality alignment, cross-scene stability, and behavioral coherence. translated_title: 文生图生成中的特质坍塌：视觉叙事中人格不一致性的评估与缓解
translated_abstract: 在视觉叙事中，一个可信的角色不仅需要在各场景间保持外观一致，还需要以反映其人格特质的方式行事。当前的文生图（T2I）模型能够有效保持角色的视觉外观，却始终无法维持与人格相关的行为——我们将这种失败称为“特质坍塌”（trait collapse）。我们证明传统指标（CLIP Score、DINO相似度）无法察觉这一失败，且抽象的人格描述词和场景级情感标签在各模型中相比中性提示词并不能带来一致的改进。为了系统性地诊断特质坍塌，我们提出了ViStoryBench-Personality，这是一个故事级基准，结合了经专家验证的视觉线索词典（Fleiss' κ = 0.757）和涵盖人格对齐、跨场景稳定性与行为连贯性的六维指标体系。通过对七个T2I系统进行评估，我们确认了持续的语义……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现文生图模型存在“特质坍塌”现象——即模型能保持角色外观一致却无法维持其人格行为的一致性，并提出了包含专家验证视觉线索词典和六维指标体系的ViStoryBench-Personality基准来系统诊断与缓解这一问题。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies "trait collapse" in T2I models—their failure to maintain personality-consistent behavior despite preserving visual appearance—and introduces ViStoryBench-Personality, a story-level benchmark with an expert-validated Visual Cues Lexicon and a six-dimensional metric suite to systematically evaluate and mitigate this problem.
